fields.plant_name: Zenergy Suzhou Xiangcheng long-duration storage base
fields.parent_company: Jiangsu Zenergy Battery Technologies Group Co., Ltd (HKEX: 3677)

rows.notes: ESCALATE (50 GWh, only an 'intention agreement' per Zenergy's own FY2025 AR, Z14; no construction yet). Agreement signed March 2026 with Suzhou Xiangcheng EDZ: 50 GWh long-duration ESS (588Ah cells) in two 25 GWh phases; phase 1 construction H2 2026, production Q3 2027 (S43b); no later news. ref_year: fallback, searched (2026; no completion year for phase 2). Press differ on investment (CNY 5.2bn ESS News vs 10bn EnergyTrend/others) and one source says 'Changshu' rather than Suzhou Xiangcheng - treated as one site distinct from the Changshu plant. Zenergy's FY2026 70.5 GWh target counts a separate 20 GWh storage project; relation to this site unknown. end_market ESS from 'long-duration energy storage'.

fields.plant_name: CBAK Energy Nanjing plant (Model 32140, Phase I/II)

rows.notes: Routing candidate 'CBAK Nanjing phase II'. 4.5 GWh = Phase I 1.5 + Phase II 3.0 GWh (FY2025 release, 2026-03-30) and 'currently 4.5 GWh' (Sept/Oct 2026); Interesting Engineering (2026-08-21) said 3 GWh at that date - older figure. Nameplate 10.5 = Phase I 1.5 + Phase II 3.0 (S60b) + 6 GWh expansion due by end-2026 (S62c) - the phased, dated structure. The 'ultimate goal of 20 GWh at Nanjing' (Zacks 2026-03-30) and the 18 GWh long-term target (Interesting Engineering 2026-08-21) are undated aspirations without phase structure and are excluded (D-015). ref_year 2026 = end-2026 due date of the 6 GWh phase. The separate 12 GWh sodium-ion project is in Gaochun EDZ (own row) - not included here. installed basis: company.

fields.plant_name: CBAK Energy Nanjing Gaochun 12 GWh sodium-ion project

rows.notes: ESCALATE (12 GWh at 0.5; conditional on financing, no construction). Investment agreement with Nanjing Gaochun EDZ signed Sept 2026; 12 GWh/yr sodium-ion cells; company 'plans to advance the project in H2 2027, subject to securing financing' (ESS News 2026-10-02) - conditional, no construction. ref_year: fallback, searched (2026 = publication year; no completion year given). Judged a separate site from the existing Nanjing plant (different development zone) - the existing site's location was not confirmed, so overlap cannot be fully excluded. Chemistry from project description.

No groundbreaking or later news found (Chinese searches); 2024-26 silence suggests stalled. ref_year: fallback, searched (2023).
